head: claude/mi120-work-digest-test-control
title: test(mi120): compute the WIP ceiling boundary instead of injecting it
body:
## Summary

MI-120 asked to break a test control drawn from the live work store. That control was already fixed on 2026-09-04 by constructing both arms — verified here rather than assumed. What remained is that the ceiling boundary was only ever **injected** into the tests, never **computed** by them, so the off-by-one that silences the ceiling at exactly 8-of-8 passed the entire file. This adds two tests that build a real store on a real git ref and let `standing_state` count it.

## Architecture impact

- [x] **Not applicable** — tests only. No `src/`, `config/`, `deploy/`, no order path, no risk caps, and the WIP ceiling value is unchanged.

## Test plan

- [x] **Original defect verified already fixed, not assumed.** Built a work store at **8/8 `in_flight`** on a real ref; the whole file is green there and at the live 6/8.
- [x] **Positive control — the fixture is a working detector.** The pre-2026-09-04 control arm (`render(build_digest("HEAD","HEAD"))`) *does* go red against that same 8/8 store, so the green result above is real and not vacuous.
- [x] **The gap this PR closes, measured.** Mutating the computation to `in_flight > WIP_CEILING` — the off-by-one that makes the ceiling go **silent** at exactly 8/8, the precise state that turned the suite red on 2026-09-04 — left **all 35** tests green.
- [x] **The new tests kill that mutant.** Same mutation now fails `test_ceiling_fires_at_exactly_the_ceiling_against_a_constructed_store`; reverted, 37 pass / 1 skip.
- [x] **Both halves still asserted.** LOUD at the ceiling and QUIET under it survive unchanged, now checked twice: on the renderer with a constructed standing dict, and end-to-end from a constructed store.
- [x] `python3 scripts/ci/run_guards.py --base main` — 64 pass. (`layer-guard` needed `import-linter` installed in this container; once installed: 6 contracts kept, 0 broken.)
- [ ] CI green

## Filed for follow-ups

Audited **87 assertions across 36 tests** in `tests/test_work_digest.py`, plus **252 assertions across 92 tests** in the five other work-store test files, for the same coupling. Method carried its own positive control (the grep/AST pass returns 34 hits in the known-coupled file, 0–1 elsewhere). Two instances found, filed rather than widened into this object:

- `BL-20260905-COMMITTED-STORE-DECISION-REQUEST-TEST-DRAWS-ITS-EXPECTED-VALUE-FROM-THE-LIVE-WORK-STORE` — asserts the live store carries ≥1 decision request; margin to red is **9**, and zero is the channel's *goal* state.
- `BL-20260905-PHASE-G-TEST-PINNED-TO-ONE-LIVE-WORK-OBJECT-FILE-BY-PATH` — reads one completed phase object by hard-coded path; archiving it breaks the suite with `FileNotFoundError`.

Not fixed here, deliberately: the two rows above, and the work object `WO-20260905-TEST-WORK-DIGEST-BUILDS-ITS-CONTROL-FROM-THE-LIVE-WORK-STORE.yaml` named in the assignment does not exist on `main` (618 objects scanned).
